sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Observability must reveal how a task moves through a hierarchy of agents and dependencies.

steps.label: Goal
steps.narration: The agent receives a user goal and must decide what information or tools are required.

steps.label: Reason
steps.narration: The model plans the next action instead of answering blindly.

steps.label: Act / tool
steps.narration: The agent calls an authorized tool or function with structured arguments.

steps.label: Observe
steps.narration: Usage, cost, latency, and traces are recorded for FinOps and incident response.

steps.label: Decide
steps.narration: The loop continues, escalates to a human, or finishes with a grounded answer.

sections.title: 26.2 Trace hierarchy
sections.body:
```text
workflow.run
├── admission_control
├── supervisor.plan
├── supervisor.delegate
│   ├── supplier_agent.run
│   │   └── supplier_registry.lookup
│   ├── finance_agent.run
│   │   ├── mcp.tool.call
│   │   └── finance.verify
│   ├── compliance_agent.run
│   │   └── rag.retrieve
│   └── a2a.remote_task
├── supervisor.aggregate
├── policy.verify
└── outcome.confirm
```

The trace should distinguish a logical agent execution from individual model calls and tool calls.

sections.title: 26.3 What to record
sections.body:
A useful span or structured event may include:

```json
{
  "workflow_id": "WF-101",
  "task_id": "TASK-104",
  "parent_task_id": "TASK-101",
  "agent_role": "finance",
  "agent_version": "v3",
  "operation": "budget_verification",
  "attempt": 1,
  "duration_ms": 1800,
  "model_calls": 2,
  "tool_calls": 1,
  "outcome": "verified"
}
```

Do not collect raw confidential conversations, credentials or private model reasoning merely to obtain observability.

Use structured decisions, tool-call metadata, sanitized results and evidence references.
